name: Priority Management
overview: Scripture teaches that believers must prioritize seeking God's kingdom and righteousness above all else, trusting that their earthly needs will be provided (Matthew 6:33). The example of Martha receiving Jesus into her home (Luke 10:38) reminds us of the importance of how we manage our time and focus in serving Christ. Additionally, Colossians 3:2 encourages setting our minds on heavenly things rather than earthly distractions, emphasizing a Christ-centered approach to managing our priorities.
